Alright, so here's something that happened while playing against grand warlord voss. So he flips when there is no minions out, and flips back when there are two or more out at the start of his turn. So, I killed all of his minions and got him to flip. At the start of one of his turns, he still had no minions out, but he had forced deployment, which brought out like 12 minions. But he didn't flip back that turn.

 

Should he have? I was under the assumption that since those minions were brought out at the start of his turn, he would now have more than 2 minions out at the start and that would trigger him to flip back. If that's what's supposed to happen, then maybe grand warlord voss's start of turn check for minions needs to have lower priority. If not, then just ignore this.

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: His character card is in play before any other villain card. Since Start of Turn effects trigger in the order they entered play, his character card would be the first thing to resolve. This means he would of already checked if he flipped or not by the time Forced Deplyment triggers.

posts.name: gailon24
posts.cooked:
I was playing against Citizen Dawn last night and she had Citizen Sweat and Return with the Dawn in play.  I didn't have any ongoing destruction out but no big deal she was almost dead anyway, in fact, I killed her the next round.  Anyway, as a matter of, uh, laziness, sometimes I make a choice instead of clicking the meanwhile button, and then go back and undo after the game helps me calculate what the effect on my damage will be.  So when I "accidentally" clicked Hero A for destroying an ongoing card, and I really wanted to click hero B, I had to undo ALL the way back to Citizen Dawn's Play a Card Phase.  However, I was surpised when Return with the Dawn recalled a DIFFERENT citizen from the trash the second time around!  (In fact, it ruined my perfect kill because that citizen was left with 1 HP when I killed Citizen Dawn heh)

 

That seems kind of broken to me.  If I wanted, I could keep undoing until I got the citizen I wanted recalled from the trash.  I feel like the game should know what the order the trash is in the first time I go through it.  I understand the card calls for "shuffling the trash" and so that will result in different cards each time it's done, but being able to undo a random card doesn't seem right.

 

TL;DR: Should "undo" be able to change the result of a "shuffle and reveal"?

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
gailon24:

TL;DR: Should "undo" be able to change the result of a "shuffle and reveal"?

I think so. It's supposed to be random, so it should be. Just like it knows the actual order of the decks so it's consistently giving us the same card every time we undo back over a draw. It's emulating a real situation and following the rules to the letter.

 

Just as with the draw, yeah, we can cheat. (Now that we know what the card we're drawing is or that the villain/environment is playing, we can change our previous plays…) But it's cooperative. We can cheat when we're sitting with the cards, themselves. But we don't, because that's not fun.
